title: Everest Isn't the Tallest Mountain on Earth
description: Everest has the highest peak above sea level, but another mountain is taller from base to top.

scenes.text: Mount Everest is not the tallest mountain on Earth. It is just the highest.
scenes.subject: everest
scenes.say: [curious] Mount Everest is NOT the tallest mountain on Earth. It is just the highest.

scenes.text: Everest's peak is the highest point above sea level, at almost eight thousand eight hundred and fifty meters.
scenes.subject: everest
scenes.say: Everest's peak is the highest point above sea level, at almost eight thousand eight hundred and fifty meters.

scenes.text: But in Hawaii there is a volcano called Mauna Kea. Most of it is hidden under the ocean.
scenes.subject: volcano
scenes.say: [whispers] But in Hawaii there is a volcano called Mauna Kea. Most of it is hidden under the ocean.

scenes.text: Measured from its base on the sea floor to its top, Mauna Kea is more than ten thousand meters tall.
scenes.subject: volcano
scenes.say: [excited] Measured from its base on the sea floor to its top, Mauna Kea is more than TEN THOUSAND meters tall.

scenes.text: It depends on where you start measuring. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: everest
scenes.say: [chuckles] It depends on where you start measuring. Follow for more weird facts.
